statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains at the lower WATCH boundary because Treasury yields above 5%, oil near $107 and broad semiconductor weakness are aligned, while fresh independent evidence still does not confirm persistent one-way NQ structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The public risk state reflects unusually strong cross-asset stress; escalation above WATCH requires observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks, failed retracements, session-extreme holding or a credible delayed second leg.
headline: Tail remains at WATCH as 5%+ yields, high oil and chip weakness stay aligned
body: Fresh Reuters reporting shows the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield above 5.03% and Brent near $107.6, while fresh supplementary Finviz context shows delayed index futures lower, VIX futures higher and uniformly negative tracked semiconductor breadth. Stress is extreme, but live pathological NQ structure is not independently verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail fell from elevated levels during Monday's stressed session into WATCH and then mostly low as meaningful retracement capacity returned. The latest prior hour moved back to 20% WATCH as yields, oil, volatility and semiconductor weakness aligned, while Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 20% WATCH because Treasury yields above 5%, oil near $107 and broad semiconductor weakness are aligned without independently verified persistent one-way NQ structure. Conditional Tail peaks at 24% around the 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, then falls if retracement capacity remains intact.

forecast.analysis: Current stress is aligned across 5%+ Treasury yields, ~$107 oil and weak chips, but no fresh independent evidence confirms persistent one-way NQ structure. Tail stays at lower-bound WATCH.

forecast.analysis: Empire State prints at 12:30 UTC. Tail reaches 24% only conditionally if sustained extension, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements follow; two-way discovery would cap it.
The 13:30 UTC cash open is the strongest near-term path checkpoint. WATCH persists only if opening continuation combines with poor retracement quality.
First full cash hour: WATCH requires post-open directional efficiency to survive retracement attempts. Deeper pullbacks or two-way rotation would weaken Tail.
Mid-morning Tail eases if retracement capacity appears and cross-asset stress stops producing repeated NQ extension.
Late morning remains stressed by yields, oil and chips. Tail stays WATCH only if the path remains unusually one-sided.
Into midday, absent fresh extension or failed retracements, Tail falls below WATCH even while Stress stays extreme.
Midday volatility alone is not Tail evidence. Tail stays low unless NQ holds near an extreme and repeatedly rejects meaningful retracement.
Early afternoon stays lower-risk if two-way rotation persists. Renewed aligned extension across NQ, yields, oil and chips is the adverse condition.
With main event/open windows past, Tail remains low under orderly trade; persistent late-day extension without retracement is the main invalidation.
Approaching late afternoon, Tail remains low unless directional efficiency returns and cross-assets confirm failed NQ pullbacks.
Power-hour Tail stays low absent fresh one-way structure. A late second leg with extreme-holding and failed retracements is the adverse case.
Into the close, Tail remains low if flows are two-sided. Sustained extension into the close would raise the path-risk case.
Post-close risk recedes, though yields and oil remain stressful. Tail stays low unless overnight futures develop persistent structure without retracement.
Early overnight trading is thinner and headline-sensitive. Tail stays low absent a geopolitical discontinuity or fresh one-way futures move.
Asia-facing hours retain elevated Stress. Tail remains low unless multiple amplifiers align with an observed persistent NQ move.
Thin overnight conditions can magnify headlines, but hypothetical volatility is not Tail. Repeated extension after failed retracements is required.
Later Asia baseline stays low if markets remain mixed. A new geopolitical shock plus synchronized risk-off structure would raise Tail.
Europe pre-open can reintroduce pressure. Tail edges higher only if futures show persistent directional efficiency, not merely high yields and oil.
Early Europe precedes Wednesday Retail Sales/FOMC day. WATCH is conditional on renewed one-way futures structure; future events are not observed Tail evidence.
Wednesday's major event sequence is closer but unobserved. WATCH reflects setup risk only; higher Tail requires actual persistent structure or a credible delayed second leg.
